capabilities: Add or remove frontmatter tags across many notes or folders with a live preview
Find notes similar to the active note using tag, title, path, and link similarity
Browse notes in a collapsible hierarchy built from nested tags
Configure tag list YAML style, similarity weights, and view sorting
extras: README warns to back up the vault before bulk edits because there is no undo, and notes that broken YAML files are skipped and large vaults can be slow.
problem: Obsidian offers no bulk editing of frontmatter tags, no tag-similarity related-notes view, and its tag tools don't provide folder-like navigation over nested tags.
summary: Tag management plugin that bulk-edits frontmatter tags, surfaces notes similar to the active note, and navigates notes through a nested-tag hierarchy.
